steps.en: Company gets a 2nd-reminder email or has opted out
steps.id: Company dikirimi email reminder ke-2 atau opt out
steps.why_en: The email sending job is switched off in the prod configuration, so automatic sending does not run.
steps.why_id: Job pengirim email dimatikan di konfigurasi prod, jadi pengiriman otomatis tidak jalan.

steps.en: Company notices that fall due are picked for checking
steps.id: Notice company yang jatuh tempo dipilih untuk dicek

steps.en: The company UEN is sent to the government data source
steps.id: UEN company dikirim ke sumber data pemerintah
steps.why_en: The UEN goes to DataHive, but the job is off in the prod setup and DataHive is not confirmed as DOS.
steps.why_id: UEN dikirim ke DataHive, tetapi jobnya mati di konfigurasi prod dan DataHive belum pasti sama dengan DOS.

steps.en: Company board and shareholder data is fetched
steps.id: Data pengurus dan pemegang saham company diambil
steps.why_en: Only ID, position code and dates are fetched, with no person name or address.
steps.why_id: Hanya ID, kode posisi, dan tanggal yang diambil, tanpa nama atau alamat orang.

steps.en: The person in office at the offence date is identified
steps.id: Orang yang menjabat saat offence dikenali
steps.why_en: Nothing checks the offence date against the term of office; board data is only written to the log.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pengecekan tanggal offence terhadap masa jabatan; data pengurus hanya dicatat di log.
